anchors.0: This kind of opening is rare, and this one may be the only one in reach
anchors.0.5: A handful of comparable openings appear over a few months
anchors.1: Comparable openings appear steadily, so this one is not the only chance

requirements.label: Pay meets the expectation you set

anchors.0: The stated pay is clearly below your expectation
anchors.0.5: The stated pay is close to your expectation but short of it
anchors.1: The stated pay meets or exceeds your expectation

requirements.label: Your skills overlap with what is asked

anchors.0: Few of the asked-for skills are ones you have used
anchors.0.5: About half of the asked-for skills are ones you have used
anchors.1: Nearly all of the asked-for skills are ones you have used

requirements.label: The scope is one you want to own

anchors.0: The day-to-day work is mostly work you would avoid
anchors.0.5: The day-to-day work is a mix of work you want and work you would avoid
anchors.1: The day-to-day work is mostly work you want to be doing

requirements.label: The level matches where you are

anchors.0: The level is well above or well below where you are
anchors.0.5: The level is one step away from where you are
anchors.1: The level matches where you are

requirements.label: There is room to learn and progress

anchors.0: Nothing suggests you would learn or progress here
anchors.0.5: Some learning is likely, with no clear path forward
anchors.1: There is visible learning and a clear path forward

requirements.label: The organisation's purpose is one you can stand behind

anchors.0: You would be uncomfortable explaining what the organisation does
anchors.0.5: You are indifferent to what the organisation does
anchors.1: You would be glad to explain what the organisation does

requirements.label: The organisation looks likely to last

anchors.0: There are signs the organisation may not last the year
anchors.0.5: There are no warning signs, and no strong evidence either way
anchors.1: There is clear evidence the organisation is established and sustainable

requirements.label: The hiring process is clear and respects your time

anchors.0: The steps, timing or expectations are unclear or keep changing
anchors.0.5: The steps are clear but slow or heavier than they need to be
anchors.1: The steps are clear, timely and proportionate

requirements.label: The people you would work with look like a good match

anchors.0: What you have seen of the people gives you doubts
anchors.0.5: You have seen too little of the people to be sure, or the signals are mixed
anchors.1: What you have seen of the people makes you want to work with them

requirements.label: The practical terms work for your life

anchors.0: The practical terms cannot be made to work for you
anchors.0.5: The practical terms work with some compromise
anchors.1: The practical terms work as stated
